entries.german:
Mechtildis, die Witwe des Chunrad von Haichenbach, und ihr Sohn Rüdiger schenken dem Kloster Schlägl ein Drittel des Hofes zu Wandschamel als Seelgerät und verkaufen diesem die zwei Drittel um 32 Pfund; gleichzeitig bestätigen sie die Schenkung des Wernher von Haichenbach von zwei Mansen zu Harau.

"Acta sollempniter delet obliuio, nisi litterarum fulciantur stabilj firmamento. Inde est, quod ego Mechtildis(1), vidua relicta Chvnradi(2), cum filio suo Rvdigero(3), vocati de Heichenbach(4), omnibus successoribus nostre posteritatis nec non et vniuersis littere presentis inspectoribus, notum esse uolumus, quod nos kuriam nostram in Wantschaben(5) domui sancte Marie in Slage contulimus terciam partem pro peccatis et salute nostra, nec non et pro remedio animarum cognationis nostre, duas uero reliquas partes eiusdem curie pro pecunia uidelicet XXXII libris(5a) dedimus pleno iure. Fatemur insuper, quod frater Rudigeri, scilicet Wernherus(6) beate memorie pro iniuria, quam predicte domuj intulerat, emendanda, duos mansos in Horowe(7) ipsi domui, cum adhuc uiueret, contulit personaliter et concessit, cuius donationem ratam habentes consensum nostrum in hac parte et fauorem beniuolum exhibemus tam in supradicta curia in Wantschaben, quam in eisdem duobus mansis in Horowe coram altari in sepedicta ecclesia sancte Marie juri nostro integraliter renunciantes. Ne uero de hac donatione legittima ab aliquo heredum nostrorum dubitari possit in posterum, coram ydoneis testibus Heidenrico(8), scilicet nostro cognato de Heichenbach, Chalhoho(9) et Leupoldo(10), fratribus de Valchensteyn (11), Pilgrimo de Tanneberch(12), Sybotone de Sprinzensteyn(13), Wernhardo de Monte(14), Vlrico Gusner(15), Chunrado Chraenzinger(16), presentem paginam sepedicte domui sancte Marie dedimus, sigilli nostrj robore confirmatam. Prefati nichilominus testes eundem contractum conscriptum presentibus suorum sigillorum testimonio signauerunt. Datum in Slage, VIIIo. jdus marcii, anno ab incarnatione Domini millesimo ducentesimo quinquagesimo tercio."

Siegel: Vier Fragmente von Siegeln, an Pergamentbändchen hängend: 1) Mechtildis von Haichenbach: Fragment, 27 mm hoch. 2) Konventsiegel von Schlägl: Fragment, 25 mm hoch; Madonna mit dem Kind. 3) Heinrich von Haichenbach: Dreieckiges Siegel; untere Ecke fehlt; 30 x 33 mm. 4) Rüdiger von Haichenbach (?) Siegel fehlt, nur Pergamentbändchen erhalten.
entries.english:
Mechtildis, widow of Chunrad of Haichenbach, and her son Rüdiger give one third of the estate at Wandschamel to Schlägl Monastery as an offering for the salvation of souls, and sell the remaining two thirds to it for 32 pounds; at the same time they confirm Wernher of Haichenbach’s gift of two manses at Harau.

Deeds are solemnly erased by oblivion unless supported by the firm foundation of written records. Therefore I, Mechtildis, widow left by Chunrad, together with her son Rüdiger, called of Haichenbach, wish it to be known to all our successors and to everyone who sees this letter that we have granted to the house of St. Mary at Schlägl one third of our estate at Wandschamel for our sins and salvation and for the salvation of the souls of our kin, and have given the other two parts of the same estate in full right for the sum of 32 pounds. We further acknowledge that Rüdiger’s brother, namely Wernher, of blessed memory, gave and granted in person to that house, while he was still alive, two manses at Harau, to make amends for the injury he had inflicted on it. Approving this gift, we offer our consent and willing support both for the aforesaid estate at Wandschamel and for those two manses at Harau, renouncing in full our rights before the altar in the aforesaid church of St. Mary. So that none of our heirs may in future doubt the legitimacy of this gift, we have given this charter to the aforesaid house of St. Mary, confirmed by the force of our seal, before suitable witnesses: Heidenricus, our kinsman of Haichenbach; Chalhoho and Leupold, brothers of Falkenstein; Pilgrim of Tanneberg; Sybotone of Sprinzenstein; Wernhard of Monte; Ulricus Gusner; and Chunrad Chraenzinger. The aforesaid witnesses also sealed the written agreement with their seals. Given at Schlägl, on the eighth Ides of March, in the year of the Lord’s Incarnation 1253.

Four seal fragments hang from parchment strips: (1) Mechtildis of Haichenbach, fragment, 27 mm high; (2) convent seal of Schlägl, fragment, 25 mm high, showing the Madonna and Child; (3) Heinrich of Haichenbach, triangular seal, lower corner missing, 30 x 33 mm; (4) the seal of Rüdiger of Haichenbach (?) is missing; only the parchment strip remains.
